homeAdvantagesSection.subTitle: EyeDetect is a next-generation polygraph test that records involuntary micro-movements of the eyes. Thanks to automation, we offer reasonable prices for polygraph services in Lviv for both businesses and private clients.

homePaths.title: Two ways to learn the truth

office.badge: In our Lviv office or on-site
office.title: EyeDetect
office.text: A test on Converus equipment in Lviv or on-site at your location, with the examiner present.

online.title: VerifEye
online.text: The person opens a link in the VerifEye app on their smartphone, listens to the questions and answers out loud. The algorithm evaluates the eye reactions.

steps.title: Conversation and question design
steps.text: You explain the situation and together we formulate 1–3 specific questions.

steps.title: A 30–45 minute test
steps.text: The person sits in front of a camera and answers “true” or “false” to statements. The equipment records eye reactions that cannot be controlled.

steps.title: Report right after the test
steps.text: The Converus algorithm calculates the Credibility Score within 5 minutes. You receive an automated PDF report.

homeReport.title: What you receive
homeReport.subTitle: A written EyeDetect report with a Credibility Score. Below is a real report with the client’s data blurred.
points: A Credibility Score from 1 to 99: 50 and above is “credible”, below 50 is “not credible”. In a multi-topic test, each topic gets its own score
Answers to every statement, so you can see how the score was formed
If the algorithm could not score the test (instructions not followed, random answers, eye or lighting problems), the result is treated as inconclusive. We repeat the test at our expense
homeReport.caption: A real EyeDetect report, fidelity test. Personal data blurred.

modal.title: Consultation request
modal.text: We work 24/7 and will call or message you within 15–30 minutes. Together we will agree on the questions and the date. Payment only after the booking is confirmed.
